messages:
Asha: Quick follow-up to the postmortem notes — we should turn the recurring tail-latency issue into concrete eval artifacts (regression promptset + extended perf + a short chaos run). Creating ownership thread here.

Rob: Agreed. I can take the regression harness work and CI gating. Plan: nightlies + pre-merge smoke.

Carlos: I'll curate the promptset from the postmortem appendix (8 definite fails, 5 near-misses). Will tag each with repro steps and data provenance. ETA 7 business days.

Nina: I'll extend load scenarios: seq lengths 256/512/1024 and stepped concurrency 1/4/16. Also add a dashboard panel for P99.9 tail. ETA ~10 days.

Asha: Proposed acceptance: absolute quality delta <= 2% on curated promptset; P95 latency regression <= +20% vs baseline for 0-1024 tokens. If quality delta > 2.5% auto-create RD-3501 draft.

Rob: For PR template I'll add a checklist snippet:
```
- suite: incident-1991
- owner: @Rob/@Carlos
- test-cmd: ./ci/run_eval --suite incident-1991
- golden: infra/evals/incident-1991/golden.json.gz
- reproducibility: seed + model-hash
```

AlertBot: Created ticket RD-3501 "Incident-driven evals: incident-1991" and linked to board "Platform: Incident Remediation".

Carlos: Note: a few prompts include user-provided context; I'll scrub and add provenance notes (redaction method + original hash).

Nina: For the chaos run I propose network latency bump + fallback to smaller quantized variant to validate graceful degradation. I'll run first experiment off-peak next Monday 03:30 UTC and record logs.

Asha: Good. Let's also wire alerts: nightly regression failure >1.5% post top 5 failing prompts to #eng-ml; >2.5% create RD-3501 P1 draft and page owners. Rob — can you add webhook?

Rob: Yep, will add Slack webhook + attach failing examples. Also will ensure CI leaves artifacts at infra/evals/incident-1991/artifacts/.

Asha: Owners: Carlos (promptset), Rob (regression CI), Nina (perf + chaos). I'll run weekly check-ins until 3 successful full runs. Sync Thursday 11:00 to review initial results. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
